main_idea: A simple prompt cuts clutter from 29-61% to near 0%
ideas: Raw prompts leave 29-61% clutter across models
Simple prompts drop every model to 0-6%
summary: Clean and short apart from one missing link: the bars are not aligned to their model rows and the axis scales conflict, so the reader cannot tell which result belongs to which model.

missing.why: Bars sit between the model rows, so a reader cannot tell which bar belongs to which model.

Bar lengths do not match their value labels (61% bar near 55)
Two y-axis scales (percent ticks and 0-80 numbers) conflict
Second x-axis scale 0-80 has no unit
Grid lines and bars overlap in Sonnet and Haiku rows
